single.rationale: Lincoln Educational Services shows strong revenue growth (18% YoY, 14% 3-year CAGR) and improving cash flow ($59M operating cash flow in FY2025), but faces significant regulatory headwinds from DOE requirements affecting 85% of revenue from Title IV Programs. The company is investing heavily in expansion (CapEx jumped to $87M), but operating margins compressed to 5.8% in FY2025 from 8.8% in FY2023, and the P/E of 58x appears elevated given execution risks in a heavily regulated sector.
